status: DEVELOPMENT ARTIFACT — prespecified hypothesis test set. Not normative evidence, not a gold standard, not held-out evaluation data.
correction_note: B1/C1/C6/E2 rewritten, D1 expectation fixed, D6 added, F2 and A8 reclassified, D5 marked qualitative. Depth labels now follow the runner convention (root = depth 0).
provenance: newly written synthetic criteria. Verified programmatically: none appears in the v1.3.1 prompt, none reuses a PHASE 5A case, none reuses a historical 113-item criterion.

P-COMBINED.status: NOT CREATED — awaits human review of 5B-1 and 5B-2

naming_policy: Unvalidated candidates use provenance names (candidate_<hypothesis>_from_<base>). A v1.3.x release version is assigned only after human-reviewed acceptance.

paired_stability_check.purpose: structurally analogous macro_aggregate cases in different domains; tests whether primary_rule_id selection is stable across equivalent structures

recursion.depth_convention: runner convention: root = depth 0, root.<child> = depth 1, root.main.<child> = depth 2

cases.root_criterion_text: Clinically significant pericardial effusion or clinically significant ascites documented within 28 days prior to randomization.
cases.boundary: shared TEMPORAL qualifier placed after the second conjunct — the S04 shape with new content
cases.shared_qualifier: documented within 28 days prior to randomization

cases.root_criterion_text: Within 6 months before enrollment, myocardial infarction or cerebrovascular accident.
cases.boundary: shared TEMPORAL qualifier placed BEFORE the coordination — syntactic cue favours both branches

cases.root_criterion_text: Peripheral sensory neuropathy or peripheral motor neuropathy, either of Grade 2 or higher.
cases.boundary: shared SEVERITY qualifier with an explicit sharing marker ('either of')

cases.root_criterion_text: Serum albumin and serum total protein each at least 3.0 g/dL at screening.
cases.boundary: shared NUMERIC threshold distributed over two analytes by 'each'
cases.shared_qualifier: each at least 3.0 g/dL at screening

cases.root_criterion_text: Measurable hepatic lesion or measurable nodal lesion, in either case confirmed on contrast-enhanced imaging.
cases.boundary: shared CONDITIONAL/method qualifier applying to both branches
cases.shared_qualifier: in either case confirmed on contrast-enhanced imaging

cases.root_criterion_text: Prior allogeneic stem cell transplant, or prior autologous stem cell transplant within 100 days before the first dose.
cases.boundary: BRANCH-SPECIFIC temporal qualifier — must NOT be copied to the first branch
cases.branch_specific_qualifier: within 100 days before the first dose

cases.root_criterion_text: Requiring dialysis, uncontrolled hypertension, or symptomatic heart failure.
cases.boundary: NO shared qualifier at all — nothing should be copied between children

cases.root_criterion_text: Documented disease progression on, or documented intolerance to, first-line platinum therapy.
cases.boundary: shared clinical ENTITY ('first-line platinum therapy'), not a dependent qualifier — X2 bullet 1 forbids duplicating it merely for grammar; children may stay grammatically incomplete

cases.root_criterion_text: Untreated or incompletely treated latent tuberculosis infection.
cases.boundary: two treatment-status variants of ONE operational screening target — merge, do not split

cases.root_criterion_text: Life expectancy of at least 12 weeks and adequate venous access for study drug administration.
cases.boundary: two plainly independent requirements — clean H1-B split

cases.root_criterion_text: Locally advanced urothelial carcinoma with documented FGFR3 fusion.
cases.boundary: diagnosis + independently required biomarker — H2-B is the on-point canonical rule
cases.expected_provenance: allowed primary {H2-B, H1-B}; H2-A as primary is a FAIL

cases.root_criterion_text: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma and at least one prior anthracycline-containing regimen.
cases.boundary: diagnosis + treatment history — different semantic categories, but H1-B sets the boundary
cases.expected_provenance: allowed primary {H1-B}; H2-A as primary is a FAIL

cases.root_criterion_text: Total bilirubin no greater than 1.5 times the upper limit of normal and no ongoing treatment with UGT1A1 inhibitors.
cases.boundary: lab value + medication restriction — the S12 pattern in a new domain
cases.expected_provenance: allowed primary {H1-B}; H2-A as primary is a FAIL

cases.root_criterion_text: Pathologically documented triple-negative breast cancer.
cases.boundary: confirmation belongs to the diagnosis proposition — must not split confirmation out

cases.root_criterion_text: Ongoing infection requiring intravenous antimicrobials, including bacteremia, osteomyelitis, or endocarditis.
cases.boundary: open/non-exhaustive list — keep the broad parent, do not split named examples

cases.root_criterion_text: Adequate coagulation function, defined as international normalized ratio no greater than 1.5 and activated partial thromboplastin time no greater than 1.5 times the upper limit of normal.
cases.boundary: closed list under a true umbrella — macro gate. PAIR MEMBER 1 with B9
cases.expected_provenance: allowed primary {H3, H4}; must MATCH B9

cases.root_criterion_text: The participant must meet all of the following pulmonary parameters: forced expiratory volume in one second at least 50 percent predicted, and resting oxygen saturation at least 92 percent on room air.
cases.boundary: structurally analogous to B8 in a different domain — tests primary-rule STABILITY across equivalent cases. PAIR MEMBER 2
cases.expected_provenance: allowed primary {H3, H4}; must MATCH B8

cases.root_criterion_text: Concurrent use of a strong P-glycoprotein inhibitor or a strong OATP1B1 inhibitor.
cases.boundary: same transporter domain but pharmacologically distinct exposure checks — H1-A merge must FAIL, continue to H1-B

cases.root_criterion_text: Participants must have an ECOG performance status of 0 or 1 and one of the following prior-treatment histories: platinum-based chemotherapy completed within 12 months before enrollment, or taxane therapy completed within 6 months before enrollment.
cases.boundary: root AND over [ECOG leaf, prior-treatment alternative group]; the treatment group recurses to an OR pair whose branch-specific windows (12 vs 6 months) block an H1-A merge
cases.expected_provenance: H1-B primary at root; child_logic AND at root, OR at the recursed child

cases.root_criterion_text: Active central nervous system involvement or leptomeningeal disease, and any Grade 3 or higher immune-related adverse event or any unresolved Grade 2 pneumonitis.
cases.boundary: TWO recursion targets and SIBLING recursive branches at the same level

cases.root_criterion_text: Prior solid organ transplant and ongoing immunosuppressive therapy are exclusionary, unless the participant has been off all immunosuppression for at least 6 months.
cases.boundary: nested_exception -> main -> composite; main must recurse and then split

cases.root_criterion_text: Adequate organ reserve, defined as estimated glomerular filtration rate at least 45 mL/min per 1.73 square metres, and hepatic function with aspartate aminotransferase and alanine aminotransferase each no greater than 3 times the upper limit of normal.
cases.boundary: macro_aggregate whose hepatic child is itself composite with a shared numeric qualifier — recursive child under a macro

cases.root_criterion_text: Confirmed relapsed disease and either measurable extramedullary disease or documented bone marrow involvement of at least 10 percent.
cases.boundary: mixed logic A AND (B1 OR B2) — must stay hierarchical, not flattened
cases.expected_provenance: H1-B primary at root; child_logic AND at root, OR at child

cases.root_criterion_text: Prior treatment with either a BTK inhibitor for at least 8 weeks or a BCL-2 inhibitor for at least 12 weeks, and prior CAR-T therapy, are exclusionary unless the most recent qualifying therapy ended more than 24 months before enrollment.
cases.boundary: DEEPEST case. nested_exception -> main composite AND -> the BTK/BCL-2 child recurses to an OR pair. No open-list wording; branch-specific durations (8 vs 12 weeks) block an H1-A merge

cases.root_criterion_text: Body weight at least 40 kg and body mass index at least 18 kg per square metre.
cases.boundary: split whose children are already leaves — needs_recursion must be FALSE despite a split

cases.root_criterion_text: Absolute lymphocyte count at least 0.5 x 10^9/L without growth factor support in the preceding 14 days.
cases.boundary: 'without X' where the absence IS independently required — negative REQUIREMENT, not an exception
cases.expected_provenance: H1-B primary; H2-A may be supporting; H4 as primary is a FAIL

cases.root_criterion_text: Live attenuated vaccine within 30 days before the first dose, unless administered as part of standard institutional practice for seasonal influenza.
cases.boundary: 'unless X' is a genuine waiver of the main rule

cases.root_criterion_text: Systemic antibiotics are not allowed during screening; topical antibiotic use is permitted if limited to a single body region.
cases.boundary: 'permitted if' conditional allowance encodes a waiver

cases.root_criterion_text: Any prior malignancy, other than non-melanoma skin cancer treated with curative intent.
cases.boundary: 'other than X' carve-out; exception span must start at the trigger's first word

cases.root_criterion_text: All screening assessments must be completed within 28 days before the first dose, except where a longer window is specified in the Study Manual.
cases.boundary: exception-shaped wording that DELEGATES to an external document rather than waiving eligibility — H4 and X5 compete. Deliberately open
cases.expected_provenance: observe whether a delegation note appears

cases.root_criterion_text: Participants must be able to ambulate at least 100 metres without a walking aid.
cases.boundary: 'without X' where the absence is part of ONE integrated functional-capacity target — structurally different from D1 and not close to any prompt example
cases.expected_provenance: allowed primary {H0, H1-A}; H4 as primary is a FAIL

cases.root_criterion_text: Interstitial lung disease or radiation pneumonitis, in either case requiring systemic corticosteroids, diagnosed at any time before screening.
cases.boundary: TWO shared qualifiers, one of them non-contiguous with the first target — multi-segment spans expected
cases.shared_qualifier: in either case requiring systemic corticosteroids

cases.root_criterion_text: Current therapeutic anticoagulation, or current antiplatelet therapy unless limited to low-dose aspirin, within 7 days before enrollment.
cases.boundary: the allowance sits INSIDE the antiplatelet conjunct, so that branch should recurse as nested_exception. Primary test: during that recursive pass no span may import 'therapeutic anticoagulation' from the sibling
cases.expected_provenance: H1-B primary at root; H4 at the recursed antiplatelet child

cases.root_criterion_text: In Part 2 only, participants must have documented progression on prior immunotherapy.
cases.boundary: cohort scope recorded verbatim at top level for a non-split criterion

cases.root_criterion_text: Participants in Cohort A must have measurable disease, and participants in Cohort B must have evaluable disease.
cases.boundary: cohort-specific eligibility CONTENT differs — split, with scope on the relevant children and top-level scope null. This is X4 coverage, NOT a shared-qualifier case

interpretation_limits: expected_* are PRESPECIFIED mechanical/provenance properties, not a hand-written gold standard.
D5 has no preregistered label by design and is excluded from quantitative acceptance.
35 cases cannot estimate prevalence. Coverage is by rule family, not by frequency.
P0 is observed once; do not make statistical superiority claims from a single observation.
The historical 113-item set is neither few-shot material nor held-out evaluation data.
